name: Four Seasons Resort Bora Bora
insider_take: This overwater paradise sits on a private motu with unobstructed views of Mount Otemanu, where every villa literally floats above crystalline lagoon waters teeming with tropical fish.
whats_special: The resort features the largest overwater bungalows in the South Pacific, each with glass floor panels for lagoon viewing and private beach access. Bora Bora's lagoon is actually an ancient volcanic crater, creating the most stunning natural aquarium you'll ever sleep above.
pro_tip: Book treatments at the overwater spa during sunset – the glass floor panels create a magical underwater light show as tropical fish swim beneath your massage table.
dont_miss: Feed the resident stingrays and blacktip reef sharks directly from your villa deck, and take the complimentary sunset sailing aboard the resort's traditional Polynesian outrigger canoe for the most Instagram-worthy shots of Mount Otemanu.
pros: Iconic overwater bungalows with direct lagoon access and glass floor panels
World-class Four Seasons service and luxury amenities
Pristine private beach and crystal-clear turquoise lagoon
Multiple dining venues featuring French Polynesian cuisine
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive location
Remote island location requires flight connections
